metadata.title: Get-ImportServerConfigurationProfilePreviewREDFISH
metadata.description: iDRAC cmdlet using Redfish OEM extension to preview Server Configuration Profile (SCP) file located on supported network share. Recommended to use this action before attempting to import the SCP file. This preview action will validate the SCP file format is correct and attribute values are valid.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Get-ImportServerConfigurationProfilePreviewREDFISH' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$idrac_password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$share_password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
